meta.title: Puppy workbench
meta.description: Draws the running session as a little island garden: the island is your computer, the dogs are the AI and the helpers it starts, the whale in the sea is the model. Sniffing a flower bed is reading a file, planting is writing, the spinning windmill is a command, the mail boat is the web, the gull to the islet is a cloud service, sitting at the door with a flower is waiting for your approval. Made for beginners. Open it from the Puppy button beside the composer, or pick a session under Puppy workbench in the left panel. Read-only: the session log is never modified or uploaded.
